title: Chapter 8.71 of the Cambridge Municipal Code
requirement: Landlords must provide a city-issued guide regarding tenant rights and resources to tenants at the inception of a tenancy and at the time legal steps to terminate a tenancy are taken.
exemptions: rental units in a hospital, skilled nursing facility, health facility, non-profit facility providing short-term substance abuse treatment, or Short Term Rental Units as defined in Article 4, Section 4.60 of the Cambridge Zoning Ordinance
quoted_span: The Ordinance also requires that a landlord provide the Guide to tenants when legal steps to terminate a tenancy are taken (ex. Notice to Quit or Summary Process).
